description: This file contains internal test classes for PyTorch models, including various nn.Module subclasses with nested structures, parameter usage, and custom sequential modules, used for testing model traversal and composition.

classes.name: UnitModule
classes.description: A simple neural network module with linear layers and ReLU activations.

classes.name: CompositeModel
classes.description: A composite model combining multiple UnitModules with linear layers.

classes.name: UnitParamModule
classes.description: A module with linear layers and a parameter matrix, performing matrix multiplication.

classes.name: CompositeParamModel
classes.description: A composite model with parameters and buffers, combining multiple UnitModules.

classes.name: FakeSequential
classes.description: A custom sequential module that wraps multiple modules and applies them sequentially.

classes.name: NestedSequentialModel
classes.description: A model with nested nn.Sequential and FakeSequential modules to test traversal order.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Defines the forward pass for each nn.Module subclass, processing input tensors.
